sentences.text: Beta-mannosidosis is linked to the gene MANBA in curated databases [e_4896f8051a88].
Alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase deficiency is linked to the gene NAGA only by inference from three subtypes, with confidence 0.475, and this may not hold for every form [e_6f119c3d6d01].
For beta-mannosidosis, reduced beta-mannosidase activity in blood and in tissue is an observed feature [e_3229ec8d07f3] [e_a753a3ef31a1].
Both observations rest on 1 of 1 in the records [e_3229ec8d07f3] [e_a753a3ef31a1].
Constellate computed that the two diseases look somewhat alike, with a score of 0.2 that is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_528faddb6bae].
For alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase deficiency, one completed study without treatment, a long-term follow-up of related diseases, is listed [e_908b4627e477].

A patient group is matched to this disease, also only by inference from a name match on its website, and a lysosomal disease network grant is listed with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_3022c27e268a] [e_bb17d0663325].
